requestStages.name: HTTP Middleware
requestStages.behavior: Body limits (default 10MB), Request ID generation, CORS validation

requestStages.name: Authentication
requestStages.behavior: Verify API key against SHA-256 hash or session cookie for /api/*

requestStages.name: Decode & Normalize
requestStages.behavior: Parse OpenAI/v1 or Responses format into neutral internal Request struct

requestStages.name: Token Saver
requestStages.behavior: If enabled (safe/balanced), run heuristic compactions (git diff, grep, find, logs) fail-open

requestStages.name: Model & Route Resolution
requestStages.behavior: Resolve model alias/combo, check route eligibility, sort by priority or round-robin

requestStages.name: Account Selection
requestStages.behavior: Filter accounts (active, credentials valid, not expired, cooldown expired), select via strategy

requestStages.name: Provider Adapter
requestStages.behavior: Translate neutral request to upstream JSON/headers, inject credentials/bearer

requestStages.name: Shared Proxy Transport
requestStages.behavior: Route via direct or proxy profile (HTTP/SOCKS5), enforce timeouts and SSRF checks

requestStages.name: Execution & Streaming
requestStages.behavior: Stream SSE chunks or return full JSON response; propagate client context cancellation

requestStages.name: Fallback / Retry
requestStages.behavior: On 429, quota exhausted, timeout, or 5xx, retry transient errors or fall back to next route/account

requestStages.name: Usage & Audit Log
requestStages.behavior: Record compact usage metrics (tokens, latency, status) asynchronously/incrementally
